svg.title: Rectangular magnetic BVP: a=20 mm, b=10 mm, I=1 A, mu_r=1
svg.desc: Analytic contours of Az; normalized arrows show B direction. Az=0 on four edges, with surface return current and zero exterior H. a=20 mm, b=10 mm, I=1 A, mu_r=1
svg.text: a=20 mm, b=10 mm, I=1 A, mu_r=1
Az=0 boundary; sheet return -I; contours Az (micro-Wb/m)
Arrows share a display length; they show direction, not B magnitude.
Translation-invariant model; physical end closure is outside this BVP.
